description: Plan animation durations. Pass `distance_px` (how far the thing moves, 0 to 5000), `size` (small, medium, large, fullscreen), `complexity` (simple, moderate, complex) and optionally `kind` (enter, exit, state-change) and `allow_long` (true to lift the 400 ms UI cap for decorative or page-level motion). Returns a recommended duration, the enter and exit pair, a five-step token scale and the rationale. The formula is our own heuristic (stated in the output), shaped by common practice; it is an estimate to tune by eye, not a standard.

complexity.description: How many things move or change at once
